nodes.label: Rowhammer Test (declined)
nodes.rationale: A loop in Windows cannot hammer chosen physical rows; it would be a fake test. An offline tool (MemTest86) is the right path.

nodes.label: TestOutcome.Error and TestOutcome.Inconclusive
nodes.rationale: A program error is never a hardware fault, and running without error but not covering what was asked is not a pass; both make the verdict Incomplete.

nodes.label: ReadingValidator (zero is not a reading)
nodes.rationale: LibreHardwareMonitor returns 0 when a RAPL/MSR counter cannot be read, and a confident 0.0 W in front of a customer is worse than 'invalid'; a stopped fan or idle link stays a real zero.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules (no fake or guessed data)
nodes.norm_label: honesty rules (no fake or guessed data)
nodes.rationale: The product's core value: an unavailable value is null, never 0; a test that did not run is never a pass; a pass needs measured evidence; sensor names only from verified catalogs.

nodes.label: Session Singletons Own Long-Running Work
nodes.rationale: Long-running work belongs to session singletons, not pages, so a run keeps going and its result stays when the technician leaves the page.
